{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
filtered_df = sales_df[
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')
]

# Check if any rows remain
print(f"Number of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {len(filtered_df)}")

# Check if revenue is numeric
print(f"Revenue column type: {sales_df['revenue'].dtype}")

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Verify the conversion
print(f"Number of non-null numeric revenue values: {sales_df['revenue_numeric'].notnull().sum()}")

# Now compute the mean revenue for the filtered group
mean_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_numeric'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue}")"}
